strings.name: Maryna Viazovska
strings.summary: Raised in Kyiv and trained further in Germany, Viazovska connected modular forms with geometry. In 2016 she proved the E8 lattice gives the densest eight-dimensional sphere packing, then solved dimension 24 with collaborators. An EPFL professor, she became the second woman Fields medallist in 2022. Her research links number theory, harmonic analysis and discrete geometry.
strings.influence.rationale: Solved eight-dimensional sphere packing and advanced related research, contributing at the intersection of discrete geometry and number theory.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Optimal packing in eight dimensions
strings.highlights.h1.text: Constructed special functions to prove the E8 lattice’s optimality.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Collaboration in dimension 24
strings.highlights.h2.text: With four collaborators proved the Leech lattice gives optimal packing in dimension 24.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Fields Medal
strings.timeline.t1.text: Honoured for sphere packing and related work; the second woman recipient.
strings.timeline.t2.title: EPFL full professor
strings.timeline.t2.text: Became full professor and number theory chair, continuing research in Lausanne.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Clay Research Award
strings.timeline.t3.text: Sphere-packing results recognised by the Clay Mathematics Institute’s research award.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Solved dimension 24
strings.timeline.t4.text: With collaborators extended the eight-dimensional method to prove Leech lattice optimality.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Solved dimension eight
strings.timeline.t5.text: Proved E8 packing optimal, applying modular forms to geometric optimisation.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Bonn doctorate
strings.timeline.t6.text: Completed doctoral research on modular functions and special cycles.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Master’s degree
strings.timeline.t7.text: Completed a master’s in Kaiserslautern, Germany, and continued mathematics research.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Born in Kyiv
strings.timeline.t8.text: Born and raised in Kyiv; later studied mathematics at Kyiv University.
